text:
maria: Heads-up — external assessment confirmed for Tues 2026-03-31. Need RBAC window, KMS grant plan, and audit-export checklist. Who can own orchestration?

jon: I can own RBAC changes. What roles/privs do assessors need exactly?

shreya: Assessor needs read-only access to logs and service metadata + presigned S3 read. Prefer ephemeral role with session tags. @eli can the KMS flow provide a short-lived DEK?

darren: We should scope the role to arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs/pt-2026-03/* and kms:Decrypt only via grant. Suggest condition aws:RequestTag/engagement=pt-2026-03 so we enforce TTL.

eli: Yep — we can issue a KMS Grant + DEK for the window. Need exact start/end times and approval. Will also enable CloudTrail data-events for kms:Decrypt.

sasha: Audit/export plan: export daily deltas to s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pt-2026-03/, include manifest.json with SHA256 checksums and a human-readable index. Do we want increased auth logging during the test?

maria: Enable DEBUG for api-auth and token-service only for the 4h window. Keep for 24h max then roll back. Ops: can automation rotate any temporary keys after window?

jon: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4089 — adds role assessor/readroom + temp-binding lambda. Need sec-eng stamp before merge.

darren: Reviewed the PR. Add expiration enforcement via session tags and link to the evidence-locker prefix before I merge. Also want a dry-run of the grant.

auditor-bot: Reminder — upload preliminary evidence to evidence-locker by 2026-03-31T20:00Z. Use manifest.json + signatures.

eli: KMS dry-run steps (draft):
```
# create a DEK and grant decrypt to assessor role
aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/pt-locker --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > dek.bin
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-locker --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/assessor-readroom --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptedWithClientToken=true
```
We'll also capture CloudTrail entries for the grant and decrypt ops.

shreya: For retest acceptance: each JIRA must include remediation notes + evidence blob (patch diff, config change, logs, screenshot). Acceptance criteria: no open critical/high exploitable vectors, or documented mitigations validated by test.

maria: How do we prove KMS activity? Need CloudTrail + SIEM correlation for kms:Decrypt and s3:GetObject. Do we export those events separately?

eli: Enable CloudTrail data events for the specific bucket prefix and KMS key. Export to a dedicated bucket with Object Lock enabled for 90 days. We'll add lifecycle to move to cold storage after 30 days.

jon: Question — assessment target: staging only or staging+prod readroom? Ops preference?

sasha: Ops prefers staging only. If auditors need prod-sampled data, open a specific request and we require extra approvals and a canary plan.

maria: Staging only for initial engagement. Ops runbook for manifest/checksum upload:
```
# on snapshot host
cd /var/log/redwood
find . -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; > manifest.sha256
aws s3 cp manifest.sha256 s3://redwood-pt-evidence/pt-2026-03/manifest.sha256 --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
Store manifest and object list in the evidence-locker.

darren: Scheduling window: 2026-03-31 16:00-20:00 UTC. Does that overlap with oncall? Need confirmation from SRE.

eli: I can cover KMS steps. Doing a dry-run today at 17:00 UTC to validate grant lifecycle. Will post results.

shreya: I'll prepare a remediation-evidence template and JIRA checklist (fields: vuln id, CVSS, mitigation, config diff, upload path, verifier).

maria: Auditors requested a retest slot 2026-04-07. We'll require a verification call and final pass criteria. Who coordinates calendar?

jon: I'll coordinate calendar and send invites after PR merge. Will include oncall, sec-eng lead, and assignee for each remediation ticket.

sasha: Add a 30m post-engagement retro to capture any gaps in logging or automation so we can feed into Optimize.

maria: Action items recap: jon — merge RBAC PR after merge checks; eli — run KMS dry-run & publish CloudTrail sample; shreya — remediation template + JIRA checklist; darren — publish change window and confirm oncall; sasha — schedule retro. Reconvene 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
